Aviation ║ A new breed of aviators is innovating new ways to fly from clean and green electric aircraft to autonomous sky taxis.

Wind ║ Engineers race to generate vast power from thin air: the wind; one of the world's biggest wind farms is being built in harsh conditions along the coast of England; a Norwegian team works on the world's first floating wind farm.

Designing ║ How are geologists, engineers and scientists collaborating on future designs for sustainable living? Singapore's Earth Observatory scientists are transforming services above and below using subterranean design solutions.

Constructing ║ Explore the future challenges facing scientists, engineers and architects in Singapore. How will they tackle resource issues and scale eco-friendly materials for carbon-neutral construction.

Regenerating ║ Scientists, architects and engineers are experimenting with innovative designs for future Regenerative Cities. Working with nature will bring harmony to cities, so all life can thrive and survive.

Resilience ║ To meet the changing needs of the future, we need to build smart, resilient cities designed to mitigate climate vulnerabilities like floods, food security threats and coastal hazards from extreme weather.

lista.descripcion: Geneticist Spencer Wells reveals how changes in humans' genetic code have fueled major changes in appearance and capabilities.
